text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The long summer training camp was finally 
drawing to a close.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the final touch for the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), I wanted one last hard push 
running alongside a rival of equal 
caliber, but—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, well, well, well?! Did you find a 
practice partner for me?
choice_data_list: Well, it's not quite that simple...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be completely frank, the current 
Marvelous Sunday is one of the most 
formidable competitors running in the 
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If that's the case, the ideal training 
partners would be the girls currently 
dominating the Senior Class, but..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those girls are inherently busy making 
their final preparations for the autumn 
season. Naturally, it becomes quite 
difficult to align our schedules.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, if it's someone you're on good 
terms or close with, they'll often accept, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. Mayano and Laurel, the ones 
I'd ask first, aren't around right now 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being Marvelous together even while apart 
is all well and good, but there's a 
practical problem. We actually need to be 
in the same place to train together.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, hmmm, but still, I really want to 
train properly for the autumn! A training 
partner, a training partner~...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Are you looking for a partner? If so, do 
you mind if I put myself forward?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Come, take my hand. I won't let you be 
bored!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
FUJI?!?!?!? It's Fuji, Fuji, 
Fuji-i-i-i-i?!?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Is that true!? Are you sure!? But why!? I 
mean—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I wouldn't have called out to 
you if I wasn't fine. No need to hold 
back, let's both run with all our might!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, I've already arranged a proper 
training ground for running. Now then, 
let's head over right away!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we arranged a joint workout with 
Fuji Kiseki, who had stepped forward, but—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...All right. Are you ready, Marvelous?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Mm☆ You're always marvelous, Fuji★

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Well then, let's begin. Are you 
ready?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ready—Go!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Dadadada...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday, naturally— but Fuji 
Kiseki as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Breakaway, acceleration, positioning, 
pacing... Her running is so polished, it's 
hard to believe she was away from the 
racing scene for so long!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now, it's showtime!! —HAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (FWOOOOSH—!!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(Fuji's running...! She's extending, 
extending, surging ahead! A 
black-tailed—shooting star!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(Amazing. Amazing, incredible, ah, 
amazing!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: I'm gettin' so excited――☆★☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Phew...!! Haa, haa, haa...~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Fujiiiiiii!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Why?! What happened?! Amazing, amazing, 
amazing, amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I was shocked! I was so amazed!! It felt 
just like a miracle!! Just like, just 
like—!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Was it "Marvelous"?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's right☆ Yes, yes, that's it★ Fuji 
just now was truly, truly, truly—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: It was MARRRVELOUS! ☆★☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, that's great to hear! Awesome!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous. More than anyone, I wanted you 
to think so— because I wanted to return 
those feelings to you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As you ran through that race, you sent 
those feelings straight to my heart over 
and over again.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Miracles. Wonders. Joys. The hope to 
celebrate being alive.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That is why— I thought to myself that I 
wanted to be like you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Just like you, I want to be able to 
deliver "joy" to someone's heart. 
...That's what made me realize it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Basically, this is how it works.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for giving me marvelousness! 
Thanks to you, I've become marvelous too!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, that's right――that's right, that's 
it!! *That's* what it was!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I will live right here—in the races.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: (—Brian back then, too!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Mabe-chan. I'm going to run in the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: (—Laurel back then, too!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"So that I can understand even more. So 
that I can feel even more thrilled— Maya 
wants to get stronger."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: (—Mayano back then, too!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(And Fuji right now is the same! Everyone, 
every single one of them, was "like 
that"!!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(Marvelous was conveyed to everyone. I was 
able to get it across, just as I wished!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: (Still—)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(And the Marvelous that everyone showed 
me! It wasn't, not at all, not one bit 
what I thought it would be!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: (Because I—I was truly amazed!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(To Laurel's strength, to Mayano's 
choice!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(To Brian's resolve, and to Fuji's 
miracle!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(I was so, so surprised! And I got so, so 
excited!!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(That's why... yeah. That's it. Marvelous 
is—)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Marvelous. Unfortunately, it seems you 
won't make it in time for the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), but...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even so, it's autumn. I will return to the 
turf before autumn ends.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So, when that time comes—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Let's run the most fun race together, one 
that'll make the whole world burst into 
excitement!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: (That's right, Marvelous is—!!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(If it spreads and connects, it'll grow 
bigger!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(Far more than I ever imagined!! Far, far 
more—wonderful!!)
